document.title: Ticket

i18n.i18nString: Nahlásenie chyby – incident v produkcii, chyba v testovacom prostredí, problém s prihlásením
Požiadavka na zmenu – zmena, nová funkcia, vylepšenie
Servisná požiadavka – služba, analýza logov, migrácia dát, databáza
Čo sa deje, odkedy, čo ste skúsili. Čím viac vieme, tým skôr pomôžeme.
Čo ste čakali a čo sa stalo
Kedy sa to smie robiť, napríklad „po 18:00".
Celá história tiketu. Vidia ju obe strany.
Toto zákazník číta. Príde mu aj e-mailom.
Toto zákazník číta. Napíšte to tak, aby to dávalo zmysel aj bez kontextu.

data.init: Internal - the customer does not see this

data.title: What do you need help with

options.option: Bug report - incident in production, bug in testing environment, problem with login
Change request - change, new feature, improvement
Service request - service, logs investigation, data migration, database

data.title: Subject
data.desc: One sentence - what do you need.

data.title: Description
data.desc: What is happening, since when, what you tried. The more we know, the sooner we help.

data.title: What you expected and what happened
Time window
data.desc: When it may be done, for example "after 6 pm".

data.title: Conversation
data.desc: The whole history of the ticket. Both sides see it.

data.title: Message to the customer
data.desc: The customer reads this. They also get it by e-mail.

data.placeholder: Send and wait for the customer

data.title: Resolution
data.desc: The customer reads this. Write it so that it makes sense without context.
